items.title: [2026-07-19] Keep every rupee you earn (Image Prompt)
items.content: Editorial marketplace hero, vertical 4:5. SCENE: a warm sunlit Indian home-shop counter at golden hour, a small business owner mid-handshake with a buyer, cash box open showing full stack of rupee notes untouched. SUBJECT: confident owner, natural candid expression, direct owner-to-buyer connection. PHONE-UI MOCKUP: a floating smartphone shows the QckServe listing screen — clean card, product photo, a bold '₹0 commission' badge and a 'Post free' button, minimal flat UI. COLOUR SYSTEM: flat colour blocking only, no gradients — QckServe orange #FF6B00 accent bands, deep charcoal #1A1A1A, warm off-white #FCF9F8; one accent used sparingly. LIGHTING: soft directional golden-hour light, gentle shadows, no harsh contrast. TYPE HIERARCHY: oversized extra-bold condensed headline 'KEEP IT ALL' with a small italic-serif kicker 'sell free' above it; tight letter-spacing, mixed weights. EYE FLOW: reserved TOP-LEFT logo zone (kept clear, logo placed manually) → headline → giant ₹0 device → phone UI → qckserve.in at bottom-left. CAMERA: 35mm, shallow depth of field, eye-level, editorial magazine framing. PERFORMANCE LAYER: thumb-stopping high-contrast composition, crisp readable text at small sizes, clean negative space. Reserve top-left logo zone; logo placed manually. --ar 4:5 --style raw --v 6.1
